mapper.sql: c.record_id, c.trans_order_id, c.trans_order_code, c.task_id, c.feedback_id, c.workstation_id, c.process_id, c.workorder_id, c.batch_code, c.source_doc_table, c.source_doc_id, c.source_doc_code, c.source_doc_type, c.source_line_id, c.source_batch_code, c.item_id, c.item_code, c.item_name, c.specification, c.unit_of_measure, c.quantity_consumed, c.consume_date, c.del_flag, c.remark, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time
left join pro_task t on t.task_id = c.task_id left join pro_workorder w on w.workorder_id = c.workorder_id left join md_workstation ws on ws.workstation_id = c.workstation_id
mapper.insert: insert into pro_trans_consume (trans_order_id, trans_order_code, task_id, feedback_id, workstation_id, process_id, workorder_id, batch_code, source_doc_table, source_doc_id, source_doc_code, source_doc_type, source_line_id, source_batch_code, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure, quantity_consumed, consume_date, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{transOrderId}, #{transOrderCode}, #{taskId}, #{feedbackId}, #{workstationId}, #{processId}, #{workorderId}, #{batchCode}, #{sourceDocTable}, #{sourceDocId}, #{sourceDocCode}, #{sourceDocType}, #{sourceLineId}, #{sourceBatchCode}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{unitOfMeasure}, #{quantityConsumed}, #{consumeDate}, '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(quantity_consumed), 0) from pro_trans_consume where del_flag = '0' and task_id = #{taskId}

select k.item_id, coalesce(b.item_code, c.item_code) as item_code, coalesce(b.item_name, c.item_name) as item_name, coalesce(b.item_spc, c.specification) as specification, coalesce(b.unit_of_measure, c.unit_of_measure) as unit_of_measure, b.unit_name as unit_name, ifnull(b.quantity, 0) as plan_qty, ifnull(c.consumed_qty, 0) as consumed_qty, round(ifnull(c.consumed_qty, 0) - ifnull(b.quantity, 0), 6) as diff_qty, case when ifnull(c.consumed_qty, 0) > ifnull(b.quantity, 0) then 1 else 0 end as over_flag from ( select item_id from pro_workorder_bom where del_flag = '0' and workorder_id = #{workorderId} union select item_id from pro_trans_consume where del_flag = '0' and workorder_id = #{workorderId} ) k left join pro_workorder_bom b on b.del_flag = '0' and b.workorder_id = #{workorderId} and b.item_id = k.item_id left join ( select item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure, sum(quantity_consumed) as consumed_qty from pro_trans_consume where del_flag = '0' and workorder_id = #{workorderId} group by item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure ) c on c.item_id = k.item_id order by coalesce(b.item_code, c.item_code) asc
mapper.update: update pro_trans_consume set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where record_id = #{recordId}
